thag1.110:1.1: Nagā nagaggesu susaṃvirūḷhā udaggameghena navena sittā vivekakāmassa araññasaññino janeti bhiyyo Usabhassa kalyatan ti. || || Usabho thero. Vaggo ekādasamo.
thag1.110:2.0: uddānaṃ: Belaṭṭhakāni Setuccho Bandhuro Khitako isi Malitavambho Suhemanto Dhammasavo Dhammasavapitā Saṃgharakkhitathero ca Usabho ca mahāmuni.
